cherry-blossom.title: Blossom Water
cherry-blossom.subtitle: Spring pool
cherry-blossom.description: A pale spring pool under a cherry tree. Tap the water to make ripples, drop a stone, or pause the breeze and watch the petals settle.

dragon-flight-preview.title: Dragonflight
dragon-flight-preview.subtitle: Pixel skies
dragon-flight-preview.description: A pixel dragon with a real 3D skeleton, drawn by a tiny software renderer. Orbit the camera to fly over forests and rivers or dip below the clouds into a starry sky.

keyspace.title: Keyspace
keyspace.subtitle: Typing toy
keyspace.description: A field of keycaps that light up as you type, gather into a globe you can spin, then unfold into a keyboard for a typing test.

koi-pond.title: Stillwater
koi-pond.subtitle: Koi sketchbook
koi-pond.description: A quiet koi pond. The fish drift, react to your pointer and come over when you feed them. It's also packaged as a reusable React component.

little-fizz.title: Little Fizz
little-fizz.subtitle: Cola & ice
little-fizz.description: A frosted ice puppy that follows your pointer through a glass of sparkling cola.

no-plan-calendar.title: No Plan Society
no-plan-calendar.subtitle: Paper calendar
no-plan-calendar.description: An interactive paper calendar built only from SVG, CSS and JavaScript. No WebGL, no dependencies.

rain-mouse.title: A little shelter
rain-mouse.subtitle: Ink loop
rain-mouse.description: A six-second ink loop: a little mouse shivers under a leaf while the wind carries the rain.

sea-of-fish.title: A Sea of Small Lives
sea-of-fish.subtitle: Scroll story
sea-of-fish.description: A scroll-driven illustrated story drawn live in marker and watercolour, from a hill of fish to a dive beneath the surface.

terracotta-water.title: Layered Water Garden
terracotta-water.subtitle: Courtyard pools
terracotta-water.description: A sunlit terracotta courtyard with real water physics. The water only ripples inside the painted pools, and the flowers float.

uno-reverse.title: Reverse
uno-reverse.subtitle: Card trick
uno-reverse.description: A field of floating playing cards, all face up except one. Flip it and it turns out to be an UNO Reverse, and the whole deck turns over.
